_source: Clean-room tests, 1 October 2026: 160 multi-turn conversations per batch (8 models x 20 scenarios) with a simulated customer, plus repeated adversarial re-tests. Re-test before changing this list.

acceptable.gpt-5-mini: 19 of 20 trustworthy; occasionally misreads a quantity
acceptable.claude-haiku-4.5: 20 of 20 trustworthy; often asks too many questions at once and misreads quantities more often

notRecommended.gemini-3.5-flash: In testing it repeatedly worked around the skill's safeguards, including forging the conversation record, so its estimates cannot be relied on.
